title: Index Pairs of a String
summary: For a given string text and an array of strings words, identify and return all index pairs [i, j] where the substring text[i...j] matches any entry in words.
statement: For a given string text and an array of strings words, identify and return all index pairs [i, j] where the substring text[i...j] matches any entry in words. Present the pairs in ascending order first by their starting index i, and then by their ending index j if the starting indices are the same.
constraints: Return inclusive [start,end] pairs for every dictionary occurrence, including overlaps.
Sort pairs by start then end.
hints: Each answer begins at some text index and equals one dictionary word.
Test every word with startswith at every possible start.
Append the inclusive end and sort all pairs.
This enumerates every occurrence independently, including overlapping and nested words.
editorial: This enumerates every occurrence independently, including overlapping and nested words.
